verse.verse_2: By the night when it darkens.
verse.verse_3: Your Lord has neither forsaken you nor hates you.
verse.verse_4: And indeed the Hereafter is better for you than the present.
verse.verse_5: And verily, your Lord will give you so that you shall be well-pleased.
verse.verse_6: Did He not find you an orphan and gave you a refuge
verse.verse_7: And He found you unaware and guided you
verse.verse_8: And He found you poor and made you rich
verse.verse_9: Therefore, treat not the orphan with oppression.
verse.verse_10: And repulse not the one who asks.
verse.verse_11: And proclaim the grace of your Lord.
